output.summary: FY2026 revenue growth (+46.5%) tracks a commodity price rally (corn +46%) while bushels fell 0.9%; the cooperative ranks mid-pack against peers, and none of the peers adopted a program. The program's effect is unproven. The cost-per-bushel gain comes from maintenance cut by $293K while deferred work orders rose to $1.26M. Harlan Junction has insurer-flagged dust and monitoring hazards and an uninvestigated near-miss. Staff report freely, but the reports are ignored, which points to an unresponsive organization and not to fear. Drying and grading knowledge sits with one retiring superintendent. The expansion case relies on peak prices and unsourced throughput. Fix the hazards, capture the knowledge, and defer the vote. Do not freeze maintenance.
